title: DeliveryReceipt
description: One immutable delivery attempt against one distribution job. Every attempt - succeeded or failed - appends exactly one receipt at attempt n+1; receipts are never updated or deleted, so a retry is always distinguishable from a first attempt. The receipt is foreign-keyed to the human authorization receipt for this subject and the publish action, so an attempt can never borrow another job's authorization.

provider.description: The distribution adapter that produced this evidence, or 'unconfigured' when no adapter resolved.

attempt.description: Attempt ordinal; unique per tenant, show, distribution, and provider.

delivery_mode.description: How the delivery was evidenced. manual_receipt means a human published elsewhere and recorded the external identifier; provider_connected requires a live adapter with an authenticated smoke receipt.

external_reference.description: The platform identifier for a delivered attempt, or the opaque failure-evidence reference for a failed one.

payload_checksum.description: SHA-256 over the package that was authorized.
